proof.text: Write $\mathcal R_W$ for coherent reduction to the strict coefficient systems on the ringed sequence site and $\otimes^{\mathrm{sys}}$ for their derived tensor. The integral tensor $T$ is the derived-limit operation, and the normalized reduction/tensor comparison $c_{M,N}:\mathcal R_WT(M,N)\xrightarrow{\sim}\mathcal R_WM\otimes^{\mathrm{sys}}\mathcal R_WN$ is obtained by applying the counit of the fixed adjunction $\mathcal R_W\dashv\mathcal L_W$ to the levelwise tensor comparison [def-pur-completed-pullback-tensor-comparison]. Since $\mathcal R_W$ is a functor on the derived category and the unit, counit and all comparisons are natural for morphisms of the inputs [lem-coef-derived-system-evaluation-calculus], $c$ is natural in both variables: $c_{M',N'}\circ\mathcal R_W(T(u,v))=(\mathcal R_Wu\otimes^{\mathrm{sys}}\mathcal R_Wv)\circ c_{M,N}$ for all integral $u:M\to M'$, $v:N\to N'$. Applying this twice gives the nested squares: $\mathcal R_W(T(T(f,g),h))$ followed by $c_{T(A',B'),C'}$ and $c_{A',B'}\otimes^{\mathrm{sys}}1$ equals $c_{T(A,B),C}$ and $c_{A,B}\otimes^{\mathrm{sys}}1$ followed by $(\mathcal R_Wf\otimes^{\mathrm{sys}}\mathcal R_Wg)\otimes^{\mathrm{sys}}\mathcal R_Wh$, and symmetrically for $T(f,T(g,h))$ with $c_{A,T(B,C)}$ and $1\otimes^{\mathrm{sys}}c_{B,C}$. By [def-pod-integral-tensor-constraints], $\mathcal R_W(\alpha^{\mathrm{int}}_{A,B,C})$ followed by $c_{A,T(B,C)}$ and $1\otimes^{\mathrm{sys}}c_{B,C}$ equals $c_{T(A,B),C}$ and $c_{A,B}\otimes^{\mathrm{sys}}1$ followed by the strict-system associator $\alpha^{\mathrm{sys}}_{\mathcal R_WA,\mathcal R_WB,\mathcal R_WC}$.

proof.text:
The strict-system tensor $\otimes^{\mathrm{sys}}$ is the tensor bifunctor of the closed tensor-Hom structure of the derived coefficient-system calculus, i.e. of a monoidal structure on the derived category of the ringed sequence site [def-coef-ringed-tensor-hom-model, def-coef-ringed-sequence-site, lem-coef-derived-system-evaluation-calculus], and the strict-system associator $\alpha^{\mathrm{sys}}$ of [def-pod-integral-tensor-constraints] is the associator of that monoidal structure. The associator of a monoidal category is natural in all three variables, so for the reduced arrows, which are arbitrary morphisms of the derived system category and need not be represented by chain maps,
$$\bigl((\mathcal R_Wf\otimes^{\mathrm{sys}}\mathcal R_Wg)\otimes^{\mathrm{sys}}\mathcal R_Wh\bigr);\alpha^{\mathrm{sys}}_{\mathcal R_WA',\mathcal R_WB',\mathcal R_WC'}=\alpha^{\mathrm{sys}}_{\mathcal R_WA,\mathcal R_WB,\mathcal R_WC};\bigl(\mathcal R_Wf\otimes^{\mathrm{sys}}(\mathcal R_Wg\otimes^{\mathrm{sys}}\mathcal R_Wh)\bigr).$$
No representative formula for $\alpha^{\mathrm{sys}}$ is used.

proof.text: Apply $\mathcal R_W$ to both composites of the claimed square and compose with the isomorphism $c_{A',T(B',C')}$ followed by $1\otimes^{\mathrm{sys}}c_{B',C'}$. For the left composite, the nested square of Step 1, then the defining equation of $\alpha^{\mathrm{int}}_{A',B',C'}$ from Step 1, then the naturality of $\alpha^{\mathrm{sys}}$ from Step 2, then the defining equation of $\alpha^{\mathrm{int}}_{A,B,C}$ read backwards and the second nested square of Step 1 turn it into the right composite. Cancelling the isomorphism gives $\mathcal R_W(T(T(f,g),h);\alpha^{\mathrm{int}}_{A',B',C'})=\mathcal R_W(\alpha^{\mathrm{int}}_{A,B,C};T(f,T(g,h)))$. The completed tensor and its map on pairs of morphisms preserve the derived-complete constructible category [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom], so both composites are morphisms $T(T(A,B),C)\to T(A',T(B',C'))$ there. Coherent reduction is fully faithful, hence faithful, on that category by [lem-pod-integral-system-reduction-fully-faithful]; hence it reflects the equality and proves the displayed naturality equation for arbitrary integral $f,g,h$, including identities, zero arrows and zero objects.

title: Naturality of the normalized integral tensor associator on derived morphisms
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, and a scheme $W$ on which $\ell$ is invertible [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension, def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. Use the derived-complete constructible category and the completed tensor of [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed, def-pur-completed-pullback-tensor-comparison], together with the normalized integral associator of [def-pod-integral-tensor-constraints]. In the derived-complete constructible integral category, with the prescribed completed tensor $T$ and normalized integral associator $\alpha^{\mathrm{int}}$, every triple of morphisms $f:A\to A'$, $g:B\to B'$, $h:C\to C'$ satisfies
$$T(T(f,g),h);\alpha^{\mathrm{int}}_{A',B',C'}=\alpha^{\mathrm{int}}_{A,B,C};T(f,T(g,h)).$$
